text: 10月19日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在2026金融街论坛年会开幕式上，明确银行间隔夜回购利率已成为货币政策调控的目标利率。市场权威专家表示，央行研究切换公开市场操作主力品种，属于货币政策框架改革的一项举措，不同于通常讲的货币政策降息加息，重点还是在不断完善利率调控的操作机制。国信证券经济研究所金融业首席分析师‌王剑认为，随着隔夜操作走向常态化，政策利率或从7天过渡至隔夜，但不宜和降息划等号。广发证券首席经济学家郭磊也提到，央行在持续完善自身的货币政策调控框架，一系列制度设计是一脉相承的，沿袭了向价格型框架转型的思路，市场也要避免将央行操作机制改革举措当作
text_en: On October 19, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng stated at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that the interbank overnight repo rate has become the target rate for monetary policy regulation. Authoritative market experts said the PBOC's study of switching the main instrument of open market operations is a measure under monetary policy framework reform and differs from what is commonly called monetary policy rate cuts or hikes, with the focus still on continuously improving the operating mechanism for interest rate regulation. Wang Jian, chief analyst for the financial industry at Guosen Securities Economic Research Institute, believes that as overnight operations become more routine, the policy rate may transition from 7 days to overnight, but this should not be equated with a rate cut.
